properties.description: Areas within Oregon's state boundary not covered by any Census ZCTA (ZIP Code Tabulation Area) polygon. Typically uninhabited public land (national forest, wilderness, high desert, rangeland) with no assigned ZIP code, even though wildfire evacuation zones can still fall here.
properties.source_oregon_boundary: OR_POLY (hand-digitized, shared with generate_wildfire_report.py's PDF map)
